retrieval: Numerical facts and locators transcribed from official SCB publications and SCB's own press releases opened with the web retrieval tool. These files are not original publisher bytes. Direct host download was unavailable; no historical access archive is established.
party_mapping: FP/Folkpartiet is mapped to L for numerical longitudinal comparison only. Older SD poll shares lacking a precise separately published point estimate remain null.

poll_source.title: SCB ME60SM0201, May 2002
poll_source.locator: PDF page 1: Utkom den 14 juni 2002. Printed pages 4–5: party val-idag point estimates; printed page 8 Table 2: corresponding intervals.

outcome_source.locator: PDF page 28 (zero-based 27), Samtliga röster: m,c,fp,kd,mp,s,v,övr and total 5303212.

waves.missingness: SD is included in OTHER in this poll, with only an approximate within-OTHER description. No standalone SD point is manufactured.

poll_source.title: SCB official press release, May 2006
poll_source.locator: SCB's own press account, 15 June 2006 09:36; individual party paragraphs and OTHER total. SD described only as approximately 0.8 percent.

outcome_source.locator: Table of parties above 0.1%, 2006 and 2010 columns: exact counts; all parties 5551278 for 2006. Seven-party counts also independently matched the 2006 report Hela riket.

waves.missingness: The standalone SD poll value is approximate, so it is not admitted as a precise eight-party calibration point.

poll_source.title: SCB official press release, May 2010
poll_source.locator: 10 June 2010 09:43, opening party paragraphs and separate SD 3.9 ±0.4 within OTHER 5.7.

outcome_source.title: SCB General Elections 2010, Part 1
outcome_source.locator: Table of parties above 0.1%, 2010 exact-count column, all parties 5960408.

revision_note.locator: Important footnotes: 2020 adjusted weighting, earlier results recomputed back to 2010; original published results available separately.
revision_note.consequence: Current-vintage 2010–2019 database values are not silently mixed with original-release values. Publication dates on today's documents do not establish independent historical real-time accessibility.
